summary: The portfolio page timeouts were caused by a config change, not the gateway deploy. At 09:52Z infra-automation applied cfg-2207 to portfolio-service, shrinking db.pool.max_size from 50 to 5 ('cost-optimisation profile small'). Steady-state concurrent DB usage was ~12 connections, so the 5-slot HikariPool saturated immediately (total=5, active=5, idle=0, waiting=40+), and /v1/portfolio/holdings requests began failing with 'could not acquire JDBC connection within 3000ms'. This propagated to api-gateway as upstream timeouts/504s, raising gateway p99 from ~205ms to ~4.3s at 09:50Z. The reported api-gateway v9.3.0 deploy (dep-5220) went live at 08:00Z but had ~1h50m of zero latency impact before onset, and gateway CPU/error profile is consistent with downstream timeouts, so the deploy is ruled out as the trigger; ledger-db was healthy, ruling out the shared DB. Fix: revert db.pool.max_size to 50 (roll back cfg-2207).

ranked_hypotheses.title: portfolio-service DB connection pool shrunk to 5 by cost-optimisation config cfg-2207
ranked_hypotheses.statement: At 09:52Z infra-automation applied config cfg-2207 to portfolio-service, reducing db.pool.max_size from 50 to 5. Steady-state demand was ~12 concurrent connections, so the 5-connection HikariPool saturated immediately (total=5, active=5, idle=0, waiting=40+). Requests to /v1/portfolio/holdings blocked up to the 3s acquire timeout, failing with 'could not acquire JDBC connection', which propagated to api-gateway as upstream timeouts and 504s, inflating gateway p99 to ~4.3s.

causal_chain.claim: pool_in_use was ~12, so 5 is undersized; pool pins at 5.0
HikariPool exhaustion: total=5, active=5, idle=0, waiting=40+
requests fail 'could not acquire JDBC connection within 3000ms'
gateway returns upstream timeout 504s and p99 rises to ~4.3s

assumptions: db_pool_in_use metric reflects the same pool governed by db.pool.max_size
the pool reduction is the binding constraint (queries themselves are not slow)

ranked_hypotheses.title: api-gateway v9.3.0 HTTP/2-to-upstream deploy dep-5220 caused the timeouts
ranked_hypotheses.statement: The reported suspicion: gateway upgrade enabling HTTP/2 to portfolio-service/order-service upstreams introduced the latency/504s.
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: Dep-5220 deployed at 08:00:00Z but gateway latency stayed ~205ms for the next ~1h50m (F10,F6). Onset at 09:50Z coincides with cfg-2207 applied at 09:52Z (F1,F2) — a ~2 minute lag — not with the deploy ~110 minutes earlier. Gateway CPU flat ~42% (F13), and the 504s are explicitly 'upstream timeout portfolio-service' (F8,F15), i.e. caused downstream of the gateway. No rollback of dep-5220 occurred and none needed.

ranked_hypotheses.title: ledger-db / infrastructure degradation behind portfolio-service
ranked_hypotheses.statement: Shared ledger-db slow queries or IOPS throttling degrade portfolio reads, causing timeouts.
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: ledger-db slow_queries stayed ~1/min and connections_active stable ~55-62 throughout (F12), so the shared DB was healthy. The failures are local connection-acquire timeouts against a 5-slot pool (F4), not query or statement timeouts. (HIST-102 is a similar-symptom but different-cause past incident.)

facts.statement: config cfg-2207 on portfolio-service reduced db.pool.max_size 50 -> 5 at 09:52:00Z.
portfolio-service logged 'config change cfg-2207 applied: db.pool.max_size=5' at 09:52:13Z.
portfolio-service db_pool_in_use was ~12 before, then pinned at exactly 5.0 from 10:00Z.
portfolio-service emitted HikariPool exhaustion errors (total=5, active=5, idle=0, waiting=43).
portfolio-service logged 142x 'could not acquire JDBC connection within 3000ms' from 09:53:19Z.
api-gateway p99 jumped from ~206ms (09:40) to ~3120ms (09:50) to ~4330ms.
api-gateway logged 134 upstream-timeout-504 WARNs for portfolio-service /v1/portfolio/holdings from 09:53:53Z.
Only deploy in window: api-gateway v9.3.0 dep-5220 at 08:00:00Z, live, not rolled back.
api-gateway latency stayed normal ~205ms from 08:00 until 09:40 despite the deploy being live.
portfolio-service request_rate was flat ~565 req/s throughout, no traffic surge.
ledger-db slow_queries ~1/min and connections_active stable ~55-62, DB healthy.
api-gateway CPU flat ~42%; error_rate rose to ~7.2% at 09:50.
Historical incident HIST-115 shows identical pool-exhaustion symptoms from an environment profile pool-size override (config_change).

assumptions: db_pool_in_use reflects the same Hikari pool governed by db.pool.max_size (the metric name and the total=5 in logs are consistent).

The 09:50 latency onset precedes the 09:52:13 config-apply log by 2 minutes due to metric bucket granularity (10-min buckets labelled at bucket start); the config is still the earliest change at onset.
No other config/deploy changes occurred that are being masked by the tool's 00:00-11:59 window (only 2 config changes and 1 deploy were returned).

timeline.event: api-gateway v9.3.0 deployed (dep-5220), enabling HTTP/2 to upstreams; latency remains normal.
Last healthy bucket: gateway p99 ~206ms, portfolio p99 ~180ms, pool_in_use ~12.
Onset: gateway and portfolio p99 jump to ~3100ms.
First 'could not acquire JDBC connection within 3000ms' error.
First gateway 504 upstream timeout to portfolio-service.
First HikariPool exhaustion log: total=5, active=5, idle=0, waiting=43.
Pool sustained pinned at 5.0; p99 sustained ~4.2s; error_rate ~7%.

recommended_actions.action: Revert config cfg-2207 on portfolio-service (restore db.pool.max_size to 50) or roll it back immediately.
recommended_actions.rationale: The 5-slot pool is the binding constraint and the direct trigger; restoring 50 returns capacity above the ~12-connection steady state.

recommended_actions.action: Do NOT roll back api-gateway dep-5220 as the incident fix.
recommended_actions.rationale: The deploy predates onset by ~1h50m with no impact and the fault is downstream; rolling it back would not address the pool exhaustion.

recommended_actions.action: Add a guardrail/validation on the cost-optimisation profile so pool reductions cannot set max_size below observed concurrency; require review for datasource pool changes.
recommended_actions.rationale: Same failure mode as HIST-115 (wrong environment profile overriding pool size); prevents recurrence.

recommended_actions.action: Alert on db_pool_in_use saturation (active==max, waiting>0) and on HikariPool acquire-timeout rate for portfolio-service.
recommended_actions.rationale: The pool sat pinned at 5 with waiting 30-57; a saturation alert would have fired at onset.

recommended_actions.action: Audit other services for recently applied 'small' cost-optimisation profiles to shared datasources.
recommended_actions.rationale: The change came from automated infra-automation; other services may carry the same undersized setting.

data_gaps: No sub-minute timeline: metrics are 10-min buckets, so the exact ordering of the 09:50 latency jump vs the 09:52:13 config-apply log cannot be resolved more precisely; the bucket labelled 09:50 aggregates 09:50-10:00.
No direct evidence of query execution time from portfolio-service (only connection-acquire timeouts); cannot fully exclude a slow-query contribution, though ledger-db slow_queries were flat ~1/min.
No telemetry/evidence from auth-service, market-data-service, redis-cache or kafka was checked; they are not on the failing /v1/portfolio/holdings path in the logs, but not exhaustively ruled out.
